title: Customer Service Advisor
description:
About the Company

Vivactive is an award-winning business that stands among the fastest growing in the West Midlands. The company s long-term aim is to become the biggest incontinence provider in Europe; here, you will have an opportunity to be part of it. Recognised as an award-winning company with outstanding people and an entrepreneurial environment, the ideal candidate will enjoy the buzz of being part of a market-leading business with exceptional people.

About the Role

As our Customer Service Advisor, you will provide knowledgeable and sensitive support to customers across phone, email and live chat. You will help customers choose suitable incontinence products, place and manage orders, resolve queries and complete associated administration. You will often support elderly or vulnerable customers and discuss personal topics, so empathy, discretion and confidence are essential.

Key Responsibilities

What you ll be doing:
- Provide warm, professional customer service, primarily by telephone, supporting customers from product advice and delivery queries through to placing orders.
- Support elderly and vulnerable customers with patience, empathy and clear communication, adapting your approach to individual needs.
- Handle sensitive conversations about incontinence, bodily functions and anatomy confidently, respectfully and without judgement.
- Manage customer queries and casework across email and live chat, including back orders, returns, refunds and delivery-related issues.
- Accurately process orders, payments and customer information while working fully in line with PCI DSS, GDPR and internal procedures.

What we re looking for:
- A naturally warm, friendly and empathetic approach to customer service.
- Confident speaking with customers on the telephone for much of the working day.
- Comfortable discussing sensitive and personal subjects in a professional, respectful manner.
- Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to explain information clearly.
- Good IT literacy and confidence in learning and working across multiple systems.
- Strong attention to detail and the ability to accurately record customer information and process orders.
- A calm, patient approach when supporting elderly, vulnerable or distressed customers.
- Good organisation and the ability to balance calls with email, live chat and administrative casework.
- A positive, collaborative attitude and willingness to contribute to a warm and friendly team environment.

Knowledge, Skills & Experience

Essential

These are the minimum requirements needed to perform the role successfully.

Knowledge
- Understanding of what good customer service looks like, including empathy, active listening and clear communication.

= Awareness of the importance of confidentiality and handling personal information appropriately.
- Understanding of the need for accuracy when processing customer details, orders and payments.

Desirable
- These requirements would be advantageous but are not essential.

Knowledge
- Knowledge of GDPR and the principles of handling personal data securely.
- Knowledge of incontinence products or experience working in a health, care or medical-adjacent environment.
- Awareness of PCI DSS requirements when taking or processing card payments.

Skills
- Ability to communicate confidently with elderly or vulnerable customers.
- Ability to handle sensitive conversations with tact and discretion.
- Confidence switching between telephone, email, live chat and administrative tasks.

Experience
- Previous telephone-based customer service or contact centre experience.
- Experience processing orders, refunds, returns or delivery queries.
- Experience supporting vulnerable customers or working with sensitive personal information.

Core Behaviours

All employees are expected to demonstrate the following behaviours:
- Customer Focus
- Puts customers at the heart of decision-making and service delivery.
- Accountability
- Takes ownership of responsibilities and delivers on commitments.
- Collaboration
- Works effectively with colleagues and stakeholders.
- Continuous Improvement
- Seeks opportunities to improve processes, services and performance.
- Respect & Inclusion
- Treats others fairly, professionally and with respect.

Working Conditions:
- The role is desk-based and involves extended periods using a computer and telephone headset
- Based in a busy, lively office environment with a high volume of telephone activity and regular interaction with colleagues.
- The office can be noisy at times, so you ll need to be comfortable working in a fast-paced, energetic environment while maintaining focus and professionalism .
- Working as part of a warm, friendly and collaborative Customer Service team.

Interview Process:

One-stage, in-person interview including a 1-hour working interview. This gives you the opportunity to see the role and systems in practice, while allowing us to assess your communication, IT literacy, accuracy and overall competence for the role.

Benefits

What s in it for you? Please take the time to read our extensive list of benefits below:
- A chance to build and grow a department in a rapidly expanding/award-winning company
- Market-leading annual leave starting at 23 days plus 8 bank holidays (31 days in total), which grows with the length of service
- Your birthday off
- We ll pay for your external training courses
- Awards and Recognition Schemes; delivering above and beyond never goes unnoticed
- Free Onsite Parking
- Complimentary tea, coffee, chilled water and soft drinks
- Pension Scheme
- Free Summer BBQ
- We care about our employee s mental and physical health with well-being practices embedded in the company
- An environmentally conscious company
- Apprenticeship Scheme
- Free Eye Tests
- Cycle 2 Work Scheme
- Monthly Social Events (Bowling, Escape Room, Bake Off, Pumpkin Carving, Wellbeing Walks etc.)
- Length of Service bonus (5/10/15 year)

Work in a fun and lively environment in an up-and-coming business! You will be a crucial member of the Vivactive team. This is an incredible opportunity for an outstanding person; if you believe this is YOU, don t hesitate to apply now.

Vivactive is an equal opportunities employer. We are committed to creating an inclusive and diverse workplace where all employees and applicants are treated with dignity and respect. We do not discriminate on the basis of age, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, marital status, race, ethnicity, nationality, religion or belief, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by law.

We actively encourage applications from individuals of all backgrounds and are dedicated to providing equal access to employment, development, and progression opportunities. Our recruitment and employment practices are based on merit, skills, and experience.

title: Accounts Assistant
company: Hays Specialist Recruitment Limited - Agency - Permanent
description:
Your new role

As an Accounts Assistant, you will support the finance function by ensuring the accurate and timely processing of financial transactions. This is a varied role involving purchase ledger, sales ledger, bank reconciliations, credit notes, and general finance administration.
Key responsibilities include:
- Processing high volumes of supplier invoices accurately and efficiently
- Matching invoices against purchase orders and supporting documentation
- Investigating and resolving invoice discrepancies with suppliers and internal stakeholders
- Reconciling supplier statements and maintaining accurate supplier accounts
- Assisting with weekly payment runs and month-end processes
- Managing supplier queries in a professional and timely manner
- Raising customer invoices and credit notes as required
- Allocating customer receipts and processing incoming payments
- Reconciling customer accounts and monitoring outstanding balances
- Completing bank reconciliations and resolving unreconciled items
- Assisting with cash allocations and monitoring customer receipts
- Maintaining accurate digital records
- Supporting the wider business with ad hoc administrative tasks when required.

What you'll need to succeed

To be successful in this role, you will have previous experience working within a finance or accounts environment and be confident managing both purchase and sales ledger activities.You will also have:
- Previous experience in an Accounts Assistant or similar finance role
- Knowledge of purchase ledger and sales ledger processes
- Good working knowledge of Microsoft Excel
- Excellent attention to detail and accuracy
- Strong organisational and time management skills
- The ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment
- Strong communication and interpersonal skills
- The ability to handle confidential information professionally
- GCSE Grade C/4 or above in Maths and English

What you'll get in return
- Competitive salary
- Temporary-to-permanent opportunity
- Valuable experience within a busy finance team
- Supportive working environment
- Opportunity to develop your accounting and finance skills

What you need to do now

If you're interested in this role, click 'apply now' to forward an up-to-date copy of your CV, or call us now.
If this job isn't quite right for you, but you are looking for a new position, please contact us for a confidential discussion about your career.

Hays Specialist Recruitment Limited acts as an employment agency for permanent recruitment and employment business for the supply of temporary workers. By applying for this job you accept the T&C's, Privacy Policy and Disclaimers which can be found at hays.co.uk

title: Accounts & Finance Coordinator
description:
Accounts & Finance Coordinator (Part-Time)

Location - Shropshire (Rural Location) Fully office-based.
Hours- 16 hours per week initially. Flexible working pattern available:
- 2 full days per week, or
- 4 half days per week

Salary £15 per hour Freelance arrangements may be considered for the right candidate.
About the Role
We are seeking an experienced, organised and proactive Accounts & Finance Coordinator to join our growing client based in the beautiful rural location of South Shropshire.

This is a key position within the organisation, responsible for the day-to-day management and coordination of financial activities while supporting the leadership team with accurate financial information, planning and forecasting.

The successful candidate will play an important role in helping the business maintain strong financial controls and gain clear visibility of its financial position, both now and in the future.

Due to their rural location, applicants must be able to reliably travel to and work from our office. This is not a remote or hybrid position.
Key Responsibilities Bookkeeping & Financial Administration
- Maintain accurate financial records using Xero.
- Process sales and purchase invoices.
- Manage bank reconciliations and financial transactions.
- Maintain organised financial records and documentation.

Payroll & Compliance
- Process payroll accurately and in a timely manner.
- Prepare information for VAT returns.
- Ensure financial records remain compliant and audit-ready.
- Liaise with external accountants regarding financial reporting and compliance requirements.

Credit Control & Payments
- Manage customer accounts and credit control processes.
- Monitor outstanding balances and follow up on overdue payments.
- Process supplier payments and oversee payment schedules.
- Coordinate factory and stock-related payments.

Cash Flow & Financial Planning
- Monitor and forecast cash flow requirements.
- Assist with budgeting and financial planning.
- Track future financial commitments and upcoming expenditure.
- Provide management with regular financial updates and reports.

Stock & Business Planning As a stock-based business, financial planning around inventory and purchasing is particularly important. The successful candidate will:
- Monitor stock-related financial commitments.
- Support planning for stock purchases and replenishment.
- Assist with forecasting future expenditure.
- Help ensure sufficient cash availability for key business commitments.

Person Specification Essential Experience & Skills
- Proven experience in bookkeeping, finance administration or accounts management.
- Strong practical knowledge of Xero.
- Experience managing payroll, invoicing, reconciliations and financial reporting.
- Excellent organisational skills and attention to detail.
- Strong numerical and analytical abilities.
- Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines.
- Confident communicating with suppliers, customers, accountants and management.
- Ability to work independently and take ownership of responsibilities.

Personal Attributes We are looking for someone who:
- Is highly organised and proactive.
- Takes pride in accuracy and attention to detail.
- Enjoys working as part of a small, collaborative team.
- Can build positive working relationships with internal and external stakeholders.
- Is comfortable working independently and making informed decisions within their area of responsibility.

Additional Information
- This role is fully office-based in Shropshire, a rural location requiring reliable transportation.
- Flexible working arrangements are available regarding how the 16 hours are worked each week.
- The role would suit an experienced finance professional seeking a part-time position that can fit around family or other commitments.
- There is genuine opportunity for the role, responsibilities and hours to develop as the business continues to grow.
